name: OpenChamber
description: Web/PWA UI for the OpenCode AI coding agent. Installs natively via Node.js/npm on top of the OpenCode CLI in an LXC (no Docker) as root's systemd user service on port 3000.

notes.text: UI binds 0.0.0.0:3000 and needs auth. Password is generated at install and saved in /etc/openchamber/openchamber.env (0600) as OPENCHAMBER_UI_PASSWORD.
Web UI: http://<container-ip>:3000 (installable PWA); health: /health. Choose a password with `var_ui_password=...`.
OpenCode CLI v2 (>= 2.2.0) is symlinked to /usr/local/bin/opencode; OpenChamber manages its own server — do not run a separate opencode service.
Add provider keys with `opencode auth login` (/root/.local/share/opencode/auth.json). Runs as a user service with lingering; prefix commands with `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/0`.
Debian only: needs Node.js >= 24.14.0, installed from NodeSource LTS. Pin with NODE_VERSION=24 at install. No Alpine path.
Update: `update` in the LXC or `pct exec <CTID> -- update`; upgrades the CLI, reinstalls @openchamber/web, restarts, and waits for /health.
